versions.changelog:
## Museum Rewards Plus 1.0

First release.

- Ten new rewards from Gunther for donating to the museum, at milestones the game does not reward yet.
- Minerals: 6, 16, 26, 36 and 46 donated give geodes, frozen geodes, magma geodes, omni geodes and gold bars.
- Artifacts: 6, 10, 25 and 35 donated give clay, mixed seeds, a rare seed and an artifact trove.
- 10 minerals and 10 artifacts together give nine blueberry seeds.
- All original museum rewards stay exactly as they are.

## Museum Rewards Plus 1.1

Letters from Gunther.

- New: the morning after you collect one of the ten new museum rewards, a short thank-you letter from Gunther waits in your mailbox. Ten different letters, one per reward, each sent only once.
- The letters only say thanks: the reward itself is still the one Gunther hands you at his desk.
- If you already collected some rewards with 1.0, the letters for them arrive the next morning.
- All rewards and milestones stay exactly as in 1.0; the original museum rewards are unchanged.

## Museum Rewards Plus 1.2

Now in German too.

- All ten thank-you letters from Gunther and their titles are translated into German. Players with the game set to German get the German letters; everyone else keeps the English ones.
- Same letters, same rewards, same milestones, nothing else changes.
